findings.trigger: Freeze Date.now at expiry * 1000; stored confidential client_secret_expires_at equals expiry; redeem an otherwise valid owner-approved code with correct secret.
findings.observed: HTTP 200; secret remains valid for its expiry second.
findings.expected: Reject at now >= expiry, consistently with the reviewed lifetime invariant.
findings.correction: Enforce expiry in the application shared client-secret verification boundary before SDK handling, using injected clock; cover token/refresh/revoke at the exact second.
findings.scope: One-second lifetime overrun; no broader authorization bypass established.

evidence_assessment.production_composition: Real HTTP SDK routes, production state transitions and Tasks tools. Signed JWT fixtures use real Google verifier. Private refresh tests retain OAuth2Client.request and mock transporter only, exercising actual refresh event production.
evidence_assessment.mocks: Permanent test fixtures only; mocks-registry.json is empty; no production substitute found.
evidence_assessment.minimality: Reuse behavioral matrices and existing fixture; private gap probes are independent evidence, not one new permanent test per VQ. No-op auth or constant issuance fails rejection/positive/reload assertions.
evidence_assessment.scope: Tracked authentication/application/tool integration/config/dependency/docs and untracked implementation reviewed. Preexisting .mcp.json, planning/review documents and auth-spike.txt excluded from implementation attribution and private files not read.
evidence_assessment.secret_handling: dotenv.config disabled by inherited NODE_OPTIONS preload for test process and spawned CLI. No .env, .mcp.json, real credentials or real Google endpoints read.
